CheckedOn is the review date; crawlAgeReportedByTool describes source freshness. Web extraction/search may use cached versions and is not a real-time application/runtime verification.
Public pages were read manually through the web tool. Source-provider terms for programmatic acquisition were not independently reviewed; this record does not certify an automated collector.
